retreat.how: first frame the placed torso moves back (away from the door) by more than 4 mm

watch_1.how: first frame after the retreat the ears are back up past halfway (ear control)

refuse.how: first frame the head plate shown is a face-withdrawn view (three-quarter back or back)

watch_2.how: first frame after 7 s the head plate shown is a face view again (side or three-quarter front)

approach.how: first frame the placed torso moves toward the door by more than 4 mm

lie_down.how: first frame the torso is more than 2 cm lower than standing

look_in.how: first frame after 26 s the face is withdrawn into the room (three-quarter-back head plate)
